existing_descriptor.notes: MALDI-TOF-MS best match: Bacillus mojavensis B1811 (Biotyper score 2.330, Table 3).

occurrences.source_assessment: The paper distinguishes the environmental isolate codes Bo1/Bo2 and Ht3 from MALDI-TOF library best-match names. Bo1 and Bo2 are reported as Serratia marcescens, with best matches ZCF25 and UCP1549; Ht3 is reported as Bacillus mojavensis, with best match B1811. These matches neither equate the actual isolates to those library stocks nor assign their genomes to GTDB species. T2 and T3 each contain six isolates; the separate T4 benchmark does not enlarge either roster. Preserve Ht3 and both candidate species; B1811 is its Biotyper best match, not a demonstrated strain synonym or genome assignment. Keep Ht1/Ht2 as separate Bacillus subtilis stocks with their existing grounded blocks, and Ht4/Ht5/Ht6 as separate Pseudomonas stocks. All five unselected mappings and the original two COMMUNITY_LEVEL nodes remain unchanged. Preserve simulated-water versus optimization/panel contexts and predictive gene/pathway limitations. The prior full review of the separate T4 benchmark is not scientific approval of T2 or T3.
